premises.text: Enterprise workers cannot get work done on personal tablets because needed apps sit behind corporate firewalls, and MDM locks down the whole device
premises.evidence_span: people working within traditional enterprises cannot get their work done today on those devices because the apps they need, like SharePoint, SAP, and Oracle, are all secured behind corporate firewalls

premises.text: WorkSpot is a container where IT manages work while the rest of the personal device remains personal
premises.evidence_span: the one place where IT manages and the rest of the device remains personal

premises.text: Existing authentication unlocks WorkSpot so users get apps and documents with one-click firewall traversal via SSL VPN
premises.evidence_span: We just did it in one click and seconds, traversing through a live SSL VPN

premises.text: A virtual file system with per-document encryption enables offline viewing and remote wipe of only WorkSpot
premises.evidence_span: We've built a complete virtual file system within WorkSpot so that Stacey can view any document offline

premises.text: Platform extends to launch native apps from within WorkSpot
premises.evidence_span: architected WorkSpot to be a platform that can be extended to support things like native apps

premises.text: IT deploys using existing security/app investments with integrations to major SSL VPN providers and no new data-center boxes
premises.evidence_span: deliver a BYOD solution using his existing and leveraging his existing investments in security and apps

premises.text: End-user work activity data powers Insights and Events apps for IT (UX, problem detection, audit/compliance)
premises.evidence_span: We take that big data and we've created two big apps for IT, Insights and Events

premises.text: Access and control are free; revenue comes from charging for end-user activity data
premises.evidence_span: giving access and control for free. What we do is change the revenue equation to charge for end user activity data
